Name: MAP_DEFAULT_INFO_PARAM_ST
Description: Per-map defaults: AI sight type, sound and reverb settings, and GI resolution overrides. The row ID is the map ID as a number (m10_00_00_00 -> 10000000).

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: AI Sight Type
Fields.Description: Sight type used by enemy AI on this map.

Fields.Name: Indoor Sound Type
Fields.Description: Whether the map GD setting "indoor" counts as "indoor" or "fully indoor" for sound.

Fields.Name: Default Reverb Type
Fields.Description: Default reverb type for this map's sound.

Fields.Name: Additional Sound Bank ID
Fields.Description: A sound bank ID to use as an additional sound bank. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Override GI Resolution: XSS
Fields.Description: Global illumination resolution override used on Xbox Series S.

Fields.Name: Override GI Resolution: XSX
Fields.Description: Global illumination resolution override used on Xbox Series X.
